validation.note: The hosted diagram validator warned that the modeled SDA/SCL nets omit pull-up parts; the hosted verification still observed the ID marker. The local system smoke is digital register-level I2C and does not model analog pull-up behavior.

gaps.detail: no power net drives the MCU (board.power.vdd_volts is not routed); VDD assumed an ideal rail, so power-on and brown-out reset are not simulated
